purpose: AI retouching of workshop photographs to remove corrosion, oil stains, paint chips and mottled wear, and show cleaner, freshly refurbished equipment surfaces.
notes: Original JPGs remain unchanged in pis/.
Photo captions describe visible equipment; the process-bath function, temperatures, materials and batch results were not supplied.
AI-retouched images are presentation assets, not inspection records.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: professional industrial website retouched workshop photograph. Input image is the exact EDIT TARGET. The user explicitly requests that machinery look NEWER and professionally refurbished: remove ALL visible rust freckles, corrosion stains, dirty speckles, oil streaks, peeling paint, chips, and patchy worn surfaces across the equipment. Do NOT preserve rust or mottled age marks. Restore continuous, uniform factory paint in each original blue/orange/green/off-white color and clean satin metallic finishes on bare metal. This must be a clearly visible improvement in surface condition, like a carefully cleaned and repainted machine, not just sharpening or changing exposure. Preserve subtle realistic material texture and lighting so it remains a photograph, avoid plastic gloss or CGI. Keep EXACT equipment design, camera angle, 4:3 composition, fasteners, screws, mesh weave, guards, pipes, wires, motors, text, numbering, flame and process-liquid appearance; do not add/remove structural parts. Do not introduce tools, people, logos, labels or text. Balanced bright professional exposure, crisp natural details. Specific surface-restoration instructions: Restore the mottled rusted front crossbar to a uniform satin blue painted surface matching the blue machine trim. Remove every brown patch, paint chip and black speck on the bar. Clean the dark rear metal panels to uniform charcoal steel. Make the wire conveyor clean and metallic while preserving its exact weave and every screw.
